description: Baxo gives authorized owners, admins, and managers read-only access to workspace growth context in ChatGPT. It can return workspace summaries, sanitized team members, review cycle status, pending reviews, stored growth themes, authorized raw answers from completed reviews, authorized raw pulse responses, pulse survey summaries, and sanitized full shoutout messages. Manager access is scoped to direct reports, anonymous pulse responses omit respondent identity, and the app never exposes member emails, billing data, secrets, unauthorized or hidden feedback, or write actions.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my Baxo workspace and show the latest review cycle status.
Help me prepare for a 1:1 using a team member's latest completed review and pulse context.
Summarize the latest pulse survey and recent team recognition.
